organizations.name: Government of Bangladesh
organizations.role: The national government oversees the portfolios shown here. Electricity, fuels and mineral resources fall under MPEMR, while nuclear organizations sit within the Ministry of Science and Technology portfolio.
organizations.publicData: The ministry and division profiles list publications for their respective sectors.

organizations.name: Ministry of Power, Energy and Mineral Resources (MPEMR)
organizations.role: Oversees national policy for electricity, energy and mineral resources. The Power Division handles electricity, while EMRD covers gas, petroleum and mineral resources.
organizations.publicData: The Power Division and EMRD portals provide information on the ministry’s structure and responsibilities.

organizations.name: Power Division
organizations.role: Coordinates electricity policy and the public bodies responsible for generation, transmission and distribution. It publishes power-sector plans and annual system-loss figures by utility.
organizations.publicData: Annual system loss by utility, agency lists and power-sector plans.

organizations.name: Energy and Mineral Resources Division (EMRD)
organizations.role: Oversees policy and administration for gas, petroleum and mineral resources. Its portfolio includes Petrobangla, Bangladesh Petroleum Corporation and the Hydrocarbon Unit.
organizations.publicData: Gas and petroleum policy, official notices and project publications.

organizations.name: Ministry of Science and Technology (MoST)
organizations.role: Provides the administrative portfolio for Bangladesh’s nuclear organizations. These include BAEC, the Rooppur project owner, and BAERA, which handles nuclear safety regulation.
organizations.publicData: Agency directory, laws and project-related notices.

organizations.name: Bangladesh Energy Regulatory Commission (BERC)
organizations.role: Regulates Bangladesh’s electricity, gas and petroleum sectors under statute. Its work includes licensing, tariff decisions and regulatory orders.
organizations.relationship: Statutory regulator with an administrative link to EMRD.
organizations.publicData: Orders, tariff decisions, regulations and licensing material.

organizations.name: Bangladesh Power Development Board (BPDB)
organizations.role: Buys and sells electricity in bulk, generates power and distributes electricity to retail customers in its own service areas. It publishes installed capacity and generation statistics by producer category.
organizations.publicData: Key statistics list installed generating capacity and producer categories. Annual reports are a source for fiscal-year generation, power purchases and distribution figures where reported.

organizations.name: Power Grid Bangladesh PLC
organizations.role: Operates Bangladesh’s national high-voltage transmission network. Formerly known as PGCB, it houses the National Load Dispatch Centre and publishes corporate yearbooks and project information on the network.
organizations.publicData: Daily operating workbooks and hourly ERP readings cover grid operations. Corporate yearbooks and project pages provide additional transmission network and project information.

organizations.name: National Load Dispatch Centre (NLDC)
organizations.role: Operates and dispatches the national grid within Power Grid Bangladesh. Its daily operating workbooks provide readings on generation, demand, load shedding and cross-border flows.
organizations.relationship: Grid dispatch centre within Power Grid Bangladesh.
organizations.publicData: Daily operating workbooks and hourly ERP readings cover national generation and demand, regional evening-peak load shedding, plant output, substation load and voltage, cross-border flows and grid event logs.

organizations.name: Bangladesh Rural Electrification Board (BREB)
organizations.role: Supports rural electrification through 80 Palli Bidyut Samities. BREB publishes board-level operating statistics, while the samities provide local distribution and customer services.
organizations.publicData: Board-level operating statistics and totals, including rural electrification and the 80 Palli Bidyut Samities. The service charter directory links to individual PBS documents.

organizations.name: Dhaka Electric Supply Company Limited (DESCO)
organizations.role: Distributes electricity in its Dhaka-area service territory. Its technical and commercial statistics cover substations, energy purchased and sold, system losses and customers.
organizations.publicData: Annual technical and commercial statistics include demand, substations, energy purchased and sold, losses and customers.

organizations.name: Dhaka Power Distribution Company Limited (DPDC)
organizations.role: Distributes electricity in its Dhaka and Narayanganj service territory. Its corporate reports are an entry point for information on energy purchases and sales, losses, customers and metering.
organizations.publicData: Corporate reports are the source for figures on electricity purchases and sales, customers, system losses and meters where published.

organizations.name: West Zone Power Distribution Company Limited (WZPDCL)
organizations.role: Distributes electricity in western and southwestern Bangladesh. Its utility reports cover network performance, and its portal provides net-metering guidance.
organizations.publicData: The portal publishes net-metering guidance. Corporate reports are the source for figures on electricity sales, customers, losses and network projects where published.

organizations.name: Northern Electricity Supply PLC (NESCO)
organizations.role: Distributes electricity in northern Bangladesh. Its annual reports are an entry point for energy sales, customer counts, system losses and network projects.
organizations.publicData: The annual report archive is the source for fiscal-year figures on electricity sales, energy input, customers, system losses and project progress where reported.

organizations.name: Ashuganj Power Station Company Limited (APSCL)
organizations.role: A public electricity generator in the Power Division portfolio. Its Ashuganj station and unit records describe generating capacity and annual output.
organizations.publicData: Ashuganj station and unit descriptions, rated capacity and annual generation.

organizations.name: Electricity Generation Company of Bangladesh Limited (EGCB)
organizations.role: A public electricity generator with conventional and renewable projects. Its project and portfolio pages describe plant status and unit capacities.
organizations.publicData: Plant portfolio, project status and unit capacities, including renewable projects.

organizations.name: North-West Power Generation Company Limited (NWPGCL)
organizations.role: A public electricity generator in the Power Division portfolio. Its station and project pages describe plants, partnerships and joint ventures.
organizations.publicData: Station and project details, owner/operator information and joint-venture disclosures.

organizations.name: Rural Power Company Limited (RPCL)
organizations.role: A public electricity generator in the Power Division portfolio. Its plant and project pages provide information on fuels, installed capacity and development status.
organizations.publicData: Plant portfolio, project descriptions, fuel and installed capacity.

organizations.name: Coal Power Generation Company Bangladesh Limited (CPGCBL)
organizations.role: A public electricity generator responsible for the Matarbari coal power project. Its project pages describe generating units, capacity and commissioning milestones.
organizations.publicData: Matarbari project and unit descriptions, commissioning and capacity updates.

organizations.name: B-R Powergen Limited (BRPL)
organizations.role: A public electricity generator in the Power Division portfolio. Its station profiles and company publications describe plant capacities and project progress.
organizations.publicData: Station profiles, project progress and capacity figures in company publications.

organizations.name: Sustainable and Renewable Energy Development Authority (SREDA)
organizations.role: Promotes renewable energy and energy efficiency. It maintains renewable project and capacity records and provides guidance on grid connections and net metering.
organizations.publicData: Renewable project and capacity records, on-grid/off-grid classification, net-metering data and guidance.

organizations.name: Power Cell
organizations.role: Provides policy and technical support for the power sector. It publishes studies on topics such as utility reliability and customer satisfaction.
organizations.publicData: Public sector studies, including a utility reliability and customer satisfaction study covering SAIDI and SAIFI.

organizations.name: Office of the Chief Electric Inspector (OCEI)
organizations.role: Administers electrical inspections and safety oversight. Its services include guidance on inspection procedures, licensing and electrical safety rules.
organizations.publicData: Inspection service information, licensing and electrical safety rules.

organizations.name: Bangladesh Energy and Power Research Council (BEPRC)
organizations.role: Supports research in energy and electric power. It publishes research material and calls for projects.
organizations.publicData: Research publications and project calls.

organizations.name: Bangladesh Power Management Institute (BPMI)
organizations.role: Provides training for the power sector and publishes training and sector resources.
organizations.publicData: Training and sector publications.

organizations.name: Bangladesh Atomic Energy Commission (BAEC)
organizations.role: Owns the Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant project and the company designated to operate it, NPCBL. Its planning and development records describe the project’s ownership and development.
organizations.publicData: Rooppur project ownership and development history.

organizations.name: Bangladesh Atomic Energy Regulatory Authority (BAERA)
organizations.role: Regulates nuclear and radiation safety, including licensing oversight. It publishes regulations, licensing information and notices about its regulatory work.
organizations.relationship: Nuclear safety regulator within the Ministry of Science and Technology portfolio.
organizations.publicData: Nuclear regulations, licensing framework and public regulatory notices.

organizations.name: Nuclear Power Plant Company Bangladesh Limited (NPCBL)
organizations.role: A BAEC-owned company designated to operate Rooppur under the Nuclear Power Plant Act, 2015. Its project and financial reports document development and operating milestones.
organizations.publicData: Rooppur project progress, annual and audited financial reports, and operator information.

organizations.name: Bangladesh Petroleum Exploration and Production Company Limited (BAPEX)
organizations.role: Explores for and produces petroleum and natural gas within the Petrobangla group. Field and well updates describe exploration and domestic production projects.
organizations.publicData: Company updates are a source for field and well projects, exploration milestones and production figures where reported.

organizations.name: Bangladesh Gas Fields Company Limited (BGFCL)
organizations.role: Produces natural gas within the Petrobangla group. Company publications are an entry point for gas field profiles and production totals.
organizations.publicData: Company publications are a source for gas field profiles and production totals where reported.

organizations.name: Sylhet Gas Fields Limited (SGFL)
organizations.role: Produces natural gas within the Petrobangla group. Its company material covers fields, gas output, condensate and related projects.
organizations.publicData: Company publications are a source for gas field output, condensate figures and project updates where reported.

organizations.name: Gas Transmission Company Limited (GTCL)
organizations.role: Operates the national gas transmission network. Its daily reports track gas entering and leaving the system and support cross-checks of national gas deliveries.
organizations.publicData: Daily gas intake and offtake reports. The report format identifies the meter points, reporting period and units used for each reading.

organizations.name: Titas Gas Transmission and Distribution Company Limited (TGTDCL)
organizations.role: Distributes natural gas in the Titas service area. Company reports are an entry point for gas purchases and sales by customer class, including power where reported.
organizations.publicData: Company reports are a source for annual gas purchases and sales by customer class, including power-sector customers where listed.

organizations.name: Bakhrabad Gas Distribution Company Limited (BGDCL)
organizations.role: Distributes natural gas in the Bakhrabad service area. Company reports are an entry point for gas purchases, sales, customer mix and service coverage.
organizations.publicData: Company reports are a source for annual gas purchases, sales, customer mix and service coverage where reported.

organizations.name: Jalalabad Gas Transmission and Distribution System Limited (JGTDSL)
organizations.role: Transmits and distributes gas within the Jalalabad system. Its reports are an entry point for service territory and annual gas sales by customer class.
organizations.publicData: Company publications are a source for service territory and annual gas sales by customer class where reported.

organizations.name: Pashchimanchal Gas Company Limited (PGCL)
organizations.role: Distributes natural gas in its western service territory. Its annual reports and service information cover customers, sales categories and service coverage.
organizations.publicData: Annual reports and service information are a source for gas sales by customer class and service coverage where reported.

organizations.name: Karnaphuli Gas Distribution Company Limited (KGDCL)
organizations.role: Distributes natural gas in the Karnaphuli franchise. Its company reports are an entry point for service areas, customers and gas sales by category.
organizations.publicData: Company reports and service information are a source for annual gas sales, customer categories and service areas where reported.

organizations.name: Sundarban Gas Company Limited (SGCL)
organizations.role: Distributes natural gas in the Sundarban franchise. Its company material is an entry point for distribution projects, customer counts and sales.
organizations.publicData: Company publications are a source for annual sales, customer counts and distribution project updates where reported.

organizations.name: Rupantarita Prakritik Gas Company Limited (RPGCL)
organizations.role: Handles LNG, CNG and LPG activities within the Petrobangla group. Its materials cover LNG imports, regasification and terminal projects.
organizations.publicData: Company notices and project pages are a source for LNG imports, regasification, terminal projects and CNG and LPG activities.

organizations.name: Barapukuria Coal Mining Company Limited (BCMCL)
organizations.role: Operates the Barapukuria coal mine. Its published production and sales records provide context for domestic coal supply to the power sector.
organizations.publicData: Annual coal production figures are available. Company reports are a source for coal sales and deliveries to the power sector where reported.

organizations.name: Maddhapara Granite Mining Company Limited (MGMCL)
organizations.role: Produces granite within the Petrobangla group. Its production and sales records primarily relate to mining and construction.
organizations.publicData: Company reports are a source for granite production and sales figures where reported.

organizations.name: Bangladesh Petroleum Corporation (BPC)
organizations.role: Handles petroleum supply, including imports and liquid fuels used in power generation. Its records and price circulars provide context for product sales and fuel prices.
organizations.publicData: Price circulars provide petroleum product prices. Annual publications are a source for imports and sales by product where reported.

organizations.name: Hydrocarbon Unit (HCU)
organizations.role: Provides technical analysis of the hydrocarbon sector for EMRD. Its Energy Scenario reports summarize fiscal-year production, sector consumption and fuel supply.
organizations.publicData: Energy Scenario reports with fiscal-year production, consumption by sector and fuel-sector summaries.

organizations.name: Bangladesh Oil, Gas and Mineral Corporation (Petrobangla)
organizations.role: Oversees 13 companies spanning gas exploration, production, transmission and distribution, along with LNG, related fuels and mining. It publishes daily gas reports and consolidated annual sector totals.
organizations.publicData: Daily gas reports and annual sector totals. Figures on domestic production, LNG contribution and deliveries to the power sector are available where reported.

organizations.name: Palli Bidyut Samities (PBS)
organizations.role: The 80 Palli Bidyut Samities distribute electricity locally within BREB’s rural electrification system. Individual service charters describe customer services and local coverage.
organizations.publicData: BREB publishes board-level totals and links to individual PBS service charters. Local customer counts, electricity sales and network totals are included where published.
